canonical_name: Daewon Pharmaceutical + Pharmus Biosciences – GLP-1/GIP/GCG/Gastrin Quadruple Agonist

current_status.data_point: Diet-induced obese mouse model: >50% body-weight reduction vs. control at day 22; fasting blood glucose reduced to as low as 70 mg/dL vs. 223 mg/dL in control

finding_history.summary: Daewon Pharmaceutical announced it would present preclinical results, co-developed with Pharmus Biosciences, for a GLP-1/GIP/GCG/Gastrin quadruple agonist at ADA 2026 (New Orleans, June 5-8). In diet-induced obese mouse models, the candidate produced >50% body-weight reduction vs. control at day 22 and reduced fasting blood glucose to as low as 70 mg/dL (vs. 223 mg/dL in control); the program also targets pancreatic beta-cell protection and kidney function improvement via the added gastrin-receptor mechanism.

source.name: Seoul Economic Daily – "Daewon Pharmaceutical Hits Upper Limit on Quad-Action Obesity Drug Preclinical Data"

finding_history.summary: Daewon Pharmaceutical shares hit the daily upper trading limit (up ~29.9% to KRW 11,240) on the day the quadruple-agonist ADA 2026 preclinical data announcement broke, before giving back gains — shares had fallen roughly 15% within days of the actual conference presentation.

source.name: The Asia Business Daily – "Daewon Pharmaceutical's Quadruple Obesity Drug Shows 50% Weight Reduction in Preclinical Trials"
